title: Number Hunt
instructions: Hide number cards around the room. Find one, say the number, then collect that many small objects.

title: Floor Is Lava Maths
instructions: Spread number-answer cards on the floor as safe islands. Call out a maths question and jump to the correct answer.

title: Hopscotch Maths
instructions: Write numbers or sums in hopscotch squares. Solve each one while hopping through the course.

title: Toy Shop
instructions: Set up a pretend shop with household objects and price labels. Buy, sell, count coins and work out simple totals or change.

title: Dice Race
instructions: Roll a die, solve a matching counting or addition task, then move that many spaces toward a finish line.

title: Double It!
instructions: Choose a small number with cards or dice, build it with objects, then make twice as many.

title: Feed the Monster
instructions: Make a box monster with a mouth. Solve a number challenge and feed it the correct number of counters.

title: Hungry Crocodile
instructions: Use a crocodile mouth made from card or hands. Compare two groups and point the open mouth toward the larger amount.

title: Sock Maths
instructions: Mix clean socks, then race to match pairs. Count the pairs, individual socks, colours or patterns.

title: Lego Towers
instructions: Roll a die or draw a number card and build a Lego tower with that many bricks. Compare tower heights.

title: Make 10
instructions: Draw two number cards and use counters to find how many more are needed to make 10.

title: Bowling Maths
instructions: Set up bottles as pins. Roll a ball, count how many fall and subtract them from the starting total.

title: Jump the Answer
instructions: Place answer cards around the room. Ask a sum and jump onto the matching answer.

title: Pattern Master
instructions: Start a colour, shape, sound or movement pattern. Copy it and add the next part.

title: Estimate It
instructions: Guess the number of objects in a jar or pile, then count them and compare the estimate with the result.

title: Measure the House
instructions: Choose household objects or rooms to measure using blocks, footsteps, a ruler or tape measure. Record the results.

title: Tallest Tower
instructions: Use blocks, cups or boxes to build the tallest freestanding tower possible, then measure and improve it.

title: Maths Workout
instructions: Link movements to numbers: five jumps, three squats and two spins. Add the movements or repeat a pattern.

title: Human Number Line
instructions: Lay number cards in a line on the floor. Stand on a number and step forward or back to solve addition and subtraction.

title: Number-Line Jump
instructions: Make a floor number line and call a starting number plus an instruction such as “jump forward three.” Say the landing number.

title: Beanbag Answers
instructions: Place numbered targets on the floor. Ask a question and throw a beanbag onto the correct answer.

title: Maths Obstacle Course
instructions: Build a short obstacle course. At each station solve a counting, measuring, shape or number challenge before continuing.

title: Skip-Count Steps
instructions: Count aloud while stepping, clapping or jumping in twos, fives or tens. Stop and predict the next number.

title: Shape Hunt
instructions: Hide or point out shapes around the home. Name each shape and describe its sides, corners and position.

title: Letter Hunt
instructions: Choose a letter and hunt for objects, labels or book words beginning with it. Say each sound as it is found.

title: Secret Message
instructions: Write a short word or clue using pictures, initial letters or simple symbols. Swap messages and decode them.

title: Write Me a Clue
instructions: Choose a hidden object and write or dictate one clue at a time until the other player guesses it.

title: Beanbag Letters
instructions: Place letter cards as targets. Say a sound or word and throw a beanbag at the matching beginning or ending letter.

title: Alphabet Rescue
instructions: Hide alphabet cards around the room. Find them and place them in order, saying each letter and sound.

title: Sound Detective
instructions: Say a sound and search for something that begins or ends with it. Take turns being the sound caller.

title: Word Builder
instructions: Use magnetic or paper letters to build a spoken word. Change one letter to make a new word.

title: Silly Sentence
instructions: Choose a few word or picture cards and arrange them into the funniest sentence that still makes sense.

title: Story Dice
instructions: Roll picture dice or choose random pictures, then tell or write a story that includes every image.

title: Finish My Story
instructions: Begin a story with one sentence. Take turns adding sentences, drawing key events or writing simple words.

title: Draw My Instructions
instructions: Give a short sequence of instructions for a picture. The listener draws exactly what they hear, then compares results.

title: Teacher Swap
instructions: The child becomes the teacher and explains a letter, sound or word game to an adult or toy pupil.

title: Phonics Hopscotch
instructions: Write letters or sounds in hopscotch squares. Hop to the sound called, or say a word using each sound landed on.

title: Word Relay
instructions: Put word or picture cards at one end of the room. Run to collect one, read it and sort or use it in a sentence.

title: Robot Blending
instructions: Say a simple word slowly like a robot, stretching each sound. Blend the sounds together and identify the word.

title: Syllable Steps
instructions: Say a word and step, clap or jump once for each syllable. Sort words by the number of syllables.

title: Sound Corners
instructions: Place sound cards in different corners. Say a word and move to the corner showing its first or final sound.

title: Letter Toss
instructions: Toss letter cards or soft letter shapes into a basket. Name the letter, sound and a word beginning with it before each toss.

title: Alphabet Obstacle Course
instructions: Build a course with letter stations. Crawl, jump or balance to each one and complete its sound or word challenge.

title: Rhyming Race
instructions: Say a word, then race to find or call another word that rhymes. Use picture cards when a prompt is helpful.

title: Word Scavenger Hunt
instructions: Choose a letter, sound or word family and search books, labels and packages for matching examples.

title: Sight Word Splat
instructions: Spread familiar word cards on the floor. Call a word and tap it quickly with a fly swatter, hand or beanbag.

title: Build-a-Word Relay
instructions: Carry one letter at a time through a relay course and arrange the collected letters to build a spoken word.

title: Vowel Jump
instructions: Place vowel cards on the floor. Say a simple word and jump to the vowel sound heard in the middle.

title: Silly Sentence
instructions: Pick random people, places and actions, then join them into a funny complete sentence.

title: Story Dice
instructions: Roll picture dice or choose images and tell a story linking every picture in order.

title: Finish My Story
instructions: One person begins a story and stops at an exciting point. The next person continues it.

title: Mystery Bag
instructions: Feel an unseen household object inside a bag and describe it without naming it. Others guess what it is.

title: 20 Questions
instructions: Choose a person, animal, place or object. The other player may ask up to 20 yes-or-no questions to identify it.

title: Weather Reporter
instructions: Look outside or use a weather picture, then present a short forecast including temperature, clothing and activities.

title: Where Am I?
instructions: Describe a familiar place without naming it. Give clues about what can be seen, heard and done there.

title: Teacher Swap
instructions: The child teaches an adult or toy how to do something, then answers questions from the “class.”

title: Invent a Game
instructions: Make up a simple game, explain its goal and rules, test it together and change anything that is confusing.

title: Act Out a Story
instructions: Choose a familiar story or invent one, then act out the characters and events using movement and dialogue.

title: Emotion Charades
instructions: Act out an emotion using face, posture and movement without speaking. Guess it and discuss when someone might feel that way.

title: Story Stations
instructions: Set up several story stops around the room. Add a character, problem or event at each stop.

title: Puppet Interview
instructions: Use puppets or toys to interview a character. Ask about their feelings, choices and adventures.

title: Describe and Draw
instructions: One person describes a picture or simple arrangement without showing it. The other draws it from the spoken details.

title: Yes-or-No Detective
instructions: One player secretly chooses something. Ask only yes-or-no questions until it is identified.

title: Question Ball
instructions: Toss a soft ball back and forth. Whoever catches it answers a question or asks the next one.

title: Sound-Effects Story
instructions: Tell a short story while another person creates matching noises with their voice or household objects.

title: Picture Prompt
instructions: Choose an interesting picture and explain what happened before it, what is happening now and what may happen next.

title: News Reporter
instructions: Present two or three pieces of family or local news using a clear opening, details and closing.

title: Story Relay
instructions: Move between marked stations, adding one sentence to the shared story at each station.

title: Telephone Game
instructions: Whisper a sentence from person to person, then compare the final version with the original.

title: Silly Choices Debate
instructions: Choose a playful question such as “Would you rather fly or breathe underwater?” Give a choice and a reason.

title: Show and Tell
instructions: Choose an object, creation or discovery to present. Explain what it is and answer a few questions.

title: Role-Play Shop
instructions: Set up a pretend shop and take turns being customer and shopkeeper, asking questions and speaking politely.

title: Compass Directions
instructions: Mark north, south, east and west in the room. Call a direction and move, jump or turn toward it.

title: Map Treasure Hunt
instructions: Draw a simple map with a route and landmarks leading to hidden treasure. Follow it, then swap mapmaker roles.

title: Continent Corners
instructions: Label four areas with continent names. Call an animal, landmark or country and move to its continent.

title: Weather Reporter
instructions: Observe the day’s weather and present a report. Mark it on a weekly chart and compare changes.

title: Land or Water
instructions: Sort pictures or toy animals and vehicles according to whether they belong mainly on land or water.

title: Globe Spin
instructions: Spin a globe or point randomly at a map. Find the place, name its continent and discover one fact about it.

title: Postcard Adventure
instructions: Choose a place and create a postcard drawing. Dictate or write a short message about what could be seen there.

title: Build a Map
instructions: Draw a map of a bedroom, home, garden or imagined island using a key and clear landmarks.

title: Country Flag Match
instructions: Match printed or hand-drawn flags to country names or map locations. Notice colours, shapes and symbols.

title: Where in the World?
instructions: Give clues about a country, city, landscape or landmark. Keep adding clues until the place is guessed.

title: North South East West Race
instructions: Put direction signs around the room. Follow a called route using north, south, east and west.

title: Map Symbol Hunt
instructions: Look at a real map, then hunt for symbols such as roads, water, parks and buildings. Create a personal map key.

title: Home-to-Marae Map
instructions: Draw the important stages of a real or imagined journey from home to the marae, adding landmarks along the way.

title: World Animal Match
instructions: Match animals to the continents or habitats where they naturally live, then move like each animal.

title: Ocean Jump
instructions: Label floor areas with ocean names. Jump to the correct ocean when given a continent or location clue.

title: Mountain River or Forest
instructions: Call a landscape type and move to its labelled area. Describe one feature of mountains, rivers or forests.

title: Capital City Match
instructions: Match a small set of countries with their capital cities using cards, a map and repeated play.

title: Pack for the Climate
instructions: Choose a destination and climate, then select suitable clothing and items to pack. Explain each choice.

title: Follow the Route
instructions: Follow a route on a floor map or drawn map using direction and distance instructions.

title: Neighbourhood Walk Map
instructions: Walk around the neighbourhood and notice landmarks, roads and turns. Afterwards draw the route from memory.

title: Time-Zone Movement Game
instructions: Assign different room areas to morning, daytime and night in other locations. Move between them as the world “turns.”

title: Build a Landmark
instructions: Build a famous or imagined landmark from blocks, boxes or recycled materials, then locate its country or region.

title: Country Clue Charades
instructions: Act out a country clue through food, animals, weather, sport or landmarks while others guess.

title: Human Compass
instructions: One person becomes a compass needle. Turn the “map” or call directions and keep pointing north.

title: Sink or Float
instructions: Predict whether household objects will sink or float, test them in water, then sort and discuss the results.

title: Magnet Hunt
instructions: Use a magnet to test safe household objects. Sort them into magnetic and non-magnetic groups.

title: Ramp Race
instructions: Roll toy cars or balls down ramps with different heights or surfaces. Predict and compare distance or speed.

title: Shadow Chase
instructions: Find and trace shadows outside or near a lamp. Revisit later and compare how their position or size changes.

title: Habitat Builder
instructions: Choose an animal and build a habitat with blocks, natural materials or drawings, including food, water and shelter.

title: Nature Scavenger Hunt
instructions: Search outdoors for items matching prompts such as rough, green, tiny or fallen. Observe without damaging living things.

title: Animal Movement Match
instructions: Choose an animal card and move like that animal. Guess it and discuss how its movement suits its body or habitat.

title: Weather Station
instructions: Record temperature, clouds, wind and precipitation at the same time each day using a simple chart.

title: Mini-Beast Search
instructions: Carefully search for insects and other tiny creatures. Observe where they live, then leave them undisturbed.

title: Plant Parts Puzzle
instructions: Use a real plant or picture to identify roots, stem, leaves, flowers and seeds, then assemble a labelled puzzle or drawing.

title: States of Matter Actions
instructions: Choose solid, liquid or gas signs. Act out how particles move in each state and move to the right sign for examples.

title: Colour-Mixing Lab
instructions: Mix small amounts of coloured water or paint. Predict the new colour before combining them.

title: Ice-Melt Race
instructions: Put equal ice cubes in different places or conditions. Predict which will melt first and compare the results.

title: Sound Hunt
instructions: Pause in different places and list or imitate the sounds heard. Sort them as natural, human-made, loud or quiet.

title: Five Senses Trail
instructions: Follow a trail of stations for sight, hearing, touch, smell and safe tasting. Describe observations with precise words.

title: Day or Night Sort
instructions: Sort animals, activities and sky pictures into day, night or both, explaining each decision.

title: Living or Non-Living Relay
instructions: Carry picture cards through a short relay and sort them as living or non-living. Explain what living things need.

title: Build a Nest
instructions: Use grass, twigs, paper or craft materials to build a nest that can safely hold pretend eggs.

title: Seed Scientist
instructions: Plant quick-growing seeds, predict what will happen and record changes with drawings and measurements.

title: Cloud Spotting
instructions: Observe clouds and match their shapes to simple cloud pictures. Describe cloud cover and expected weather.

title: Food Chain Line-Up
instructions: Give each player or card a role in a simple food chain. Stand in order and show what changes if one part disappears.

title: Push or Pull
instructions: Move household objects by pushing or pulling. Compare the force needed and the direction of movement.

title: Fast or Slow Ramp Test
instructions: Change one ramp feature at a time and race identical objects. Record which setup makes them travel fastest or farthest.

title: Make a Mini Volcano
instructions: Combine baking soda and vinegar in a tray or model volcano. Predict, observe and describe the bubbling reaction.

title: Backyard Field Journal
instructions: Choose one outdoor area to revisit. Draw or write observations about plants, animals, weather and seasonal change.

title: Puzzle Relay
instructions: Place simple puzzles at the far end of a movement course. Collect one piece per trip and complete the puzzle.

title: Human Coding
instructions: Give step-by-step commands such as forward, turn and pick up. One person acts as the robot while the other debugs the instructions.

title: What Changed?
instructions: Study a group of objects, close your eyes and let someone move, add or remove one. Identify the change.

title: Build from Memory
instructions: Look at a small block model for a short time, cover it, then rebuild it from memory and compare.

title: Pattern Moves
instructions: Copy a sequence of movements, then add one new movement each round without forgetting the earlier pattern.

title: Obstacle Course Quiz
instructions: Complete a movement course with a riddle, pattern or sorting task at each station.

title: Run and Fetch
instructions: Ask for an object matching several clues, such as “small, red and soft.” Run to find a suitable answer.

title: Scavenger Hunt
instructions: Use a list of clues to find objects around the home. Tick them off and explain how each object matches.

title: Draw It Huge
instructions: Call a shape, letter, route or idea and draw it at large scale using chalk, paper or body movement.

title: Race the Timer
instructions: Set a short timer and complete an age-appropriate sorting, building or puzzle challenge before it ends.

title: Simon Says Sequence
instructions: Perform a growing sequence of actions. Each player repeats the full sequence and adds one more action.

title: Treasure Hunt Clues
instructions: Follow a chain of simple picture or written clues leading to a hidden object.

title: Odd One Out
instructions: Show four objects or pictures where one does not belong. Choose the odd one and explain the rule.

title: Copy My Block Build
instructions: One player builds a block model behind a screen and describes it. The other follows the instructions, then compares.

title: Which Comes Next?
instructions: Show a number, colour, shape or action sequence with one part missing. Work out what should come next.

title: Maze Maker
instructions: Draw or build a simple maze, then guide a toy through it using clear directions. Swap roles.

title: Sorting Challenge
instructions: Sort mixed household objects in as many different ways as possible, such as size, colour, use or material.

title: Memory Tray
instructions: Study a tray of objects for 30 seconds, cover it and recall or draw as many items as possible.

title: Blindfold Directions
instructions: Guide a blindfolded adult or a toy through a safe open route using precise verbal directions.

title: Bridge-Building Challenge
instructions: Use paper, blocks or recycled materials to build a bridge that spans a gap and holds a small toy. Test and improve it.

title: Kupu Hunt
instructions: Choose a familiar kupu and hunt for the matching object or picture. Say the word together each time it is found.

title: Tau Number Jump
instructions: Place Māori number cards on the floor. Call a number in te reo Māori and jump to it, then count actions together.

title: Tae Colour Corners
instructions: Put colour cards in different corners. Call a tae in te reo Māori and move to the matching colour.

title: Tinana Body-Part Actions
instructions: Sing or call familiar body-part words and touch or move the correct part, using phrases from an action waiata.

title: Kararehe Animal Charades
instructions: Choose an animal picture and act it out. Guess the kararehe and repeat its Māori name together.

title: Whānau Picture Talk
instructions: Use family photos or drawings to name whānau members and practise a few simple descriptive sentences.

title: Waiata Action Song
instructions: Choose a familiar waiata with actions. Sing it together, matching the meaning with clear movements.

title: Rākau Rhythm Game
instructions: Tap or pass rākau in a simple repeated rhythm while chanting familiar kupu or counting in te reo Māori.

title: Mihi Practice
instructions: Practise a short mihi in small sections, using names and whakapapa details that the whānau is comfortable sharing.

title: Te Reo Memory Match
instructions: Make matching pairs of Māori word cards and pictures. Turn them face down and say each kupu when a card is revealed.

title: Simon Says in Te Reo
instructions: Give familiar movement instructions in te reo Māori, such as stand, sit or jump. Move only after the agreed cue.

title: Weather Words in Te Reo
instructions: Look outside and choose the matching Māori weather word or picture, then repeat it in a short phrase.

title: Count-and-Clap in Te Reo
instructions: Count claps, jumps or steps together in te reo Māori, changing the speed or stopping at a called number.

title: Pūrākau Story Acting
instructions: Listen to a whānau-approved pūrākau, then retell or act out its main events and talk about its message.

title: Māra Kai Word Hunt
instructions: Visit or work in the māra kai and find plants, tools or actions whose Māori words are being learned. Use the words during the task.
